row.team_price_text: Essential: starting at $155/month (flat, not per user)
row.evidence: Loop's help centre says 'At this time, Loop only supports Google for SSO. If using another identity provider, Loop cannot offer SSO capabilities currently.', and no SCIM or user-provisioning feature appears on the pricing page, help centre or developer docs.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Returns-management app for Shopify merchants. Plans are flat monthly prices (Checkout+ free, Essential from $155/mo, Advanced from $340/mo; no annual price shown), not per user, and staff accounts are unlimited. Staff accounts are invited and deleted by hand in Loop admin > Settings > Account. The only SSO is 'Continue with Google' (social sign-in, does not count as SAML/OIDC SSO). The public REST API (X-Authorization API keys) covers returns, orders, carts, webhooks and similar; no staff-user endpoints. None by absence: nothing on the pricing page, help centre or developer docs mentions SCIM.

user_api.notes: Loop's REST API (API keys from Developer Tools, X-Authorization header) covers returns, orders, carts, destinations and webhooks; the docs index has no staff-user or account endpoints.

okta.notes: https://www.okta.com/integrations/loop-returns/ returns 404; no Okta OIN app found.

google.notes: 'Continue with Google' social sign-in, not a Workspace Marketplace SAML app.

fallbacks.notes: Staff accounts are invited one at a time from the Loop admin; Google SSO users must still be invited first.
